name: DeepLaunch
conditions: Free listing requires adding a dofollow backlink to deeplaunch.io in your website footer.
Free submissions are reviewed within 2 days (48h); paid submissions get immediate review.
requirements: Digital tools welcomed broadly: AI image generators, video tools, chatbots, productivity apps, SaaS, developer tools, design apps — 'functional, accessible, genuine value'.
Sign-in required: Google or GitHub OAuth only (no email option shown on /login).
Two-step form: (1) Tool Information, (2) Submission Type.
Hard form limits: tagline ≤160 chars; description min 500 / max 3000 chars in markdown; logo SVG/WEBP/PNG/JPG ≤500kb; up to 4 screenshots <5MB each; max 3 categories.
preparation: Google or GitHub account for sign-in.
Tool URL, name, tagline (≤160 chars), markdown description (≥500 chars).
Square logo file ≤500kb; up to 4 screenshots <5MB each.
Up to 3 categories; pricing model; platforms.
Optional: discount code, founded year, YouTube demo, founder Twitter, affiliate program flag.
Footer backlink to deeplaunch.io for the free lane.
Plan choice: Free / One-Time Pro $9.90 / Monthly Promotion $5 first month / Featured $29.90/mo / Ultimate $199/yr.
workflow: Sign in via Google or GitHub at deeplaunch.io/login.
Open /submit and complete Step 1 (Tool Information): URL, name, tagline, markdown description, logo upload, screenshots, ≤3 categories, pricing model, platforms, optional fields.
Step 2: choose Submission Type — Free (footer backlink, 48h review) or a paid plan.
Free: place the dofollow backlink in your site footer and wait ~2 days.
Post-approval: listings editable from the dashboard (changes re-reviewed).
watchFor: Description minimum of 500 characters in markdown — short blurbs are rejected by the form.
Only Google/GitHub OAuth — no email/password registration.
Free tier explicitly asks for a dofollow footer backlink; paid tiers say 'no badge/backlink required'.

Aggressive discount strikethroughs ($19.90→$9.90 etc.) and a 'Most Popular' badge on Monthly Promotion — a subscription that keeps the tool refreshed to top monthly; cancelling reverts to basic listing.
Featured Listing bundles '10 SEO-friendly blog posts per month' — content-farm upsell.
countsAsLive: The tool has a public listing page on deeplaunch.io, visible in directory browsing and (per plan) highlighted/featured surfaces.
unknowns: Whether footer-backlink removal is re-checked post-approval.
Exact free-lane link type (the pricing copy implies the free listing itself is a 'basic directory listing'; dofollow status of the outbound link unstated).
Whether the strikethrough prices are permanent.
